problem:
B3. Miško went on a trip. After a strenuous hike, he wants to take a taxi. Taxi Mini charges 400 tolars for the start of the ride and 150 tolars for each kilometer traveled, while Taxi Maksi charges 300 tolars for the start of the ride and 160 tolars for each kilometer traveled.

A Which taxi is cheaper if Miško wants to travel from the bus station to a city 5 kilometers away?

B Which taxi is cheaper if Miško wants to travel from the bus station to an animal park 15 kilometers away?

C How many kilometers should Miško travel so that the cost is the same for both taxis?

D When is it more cost-effective for Miško to take Taxi Maksi and when is it more cost-effective to take Taxi Mini?

Taxi Mini: 400 tolars (start) + 150 tolars/km
Taxi Maksi: 300 tolars (start) + 160 tolars/km

Let me define:
- Mini cost: C_mini = 400 + 150x (where x is distance in km)
- Maksi cost: C_maksi = 300 + 160x

A) For x = 5 km:
- Mini: 400 + 150(5) = 400 + 750 = 1150 tolars
- Maksi: 300 + 160(5) = 300 + 800 = 1100 tolars
- Maksi is cheaper by 50 tolars

B) For x = 15 km:
- Mini: 400 + 150(15) = 400 + 2250 = 2650 tolars
- Maksi: 300 + 160(15) = 300 + 2400 = 2700 tolars
- Mini is cheaper by 50 tolars

So at 10 km, both cost the same: 400 + 150(10) = 400 + 1500 = 1900 tolars
Check: 300 + 160(10) = 300 + 1600 = 1900 tolars ✓

D) 
- For x < 10 km: Maksi is cheaper (lower starting cost, and the extra per-km cost hasn't caught up)
- For x = 10 km: Both cost the same
- For x > 10 km: Mini is cheaper (the lower per-km rate makes up for the higher starting cost)

answer_text:
# Taxi Cost Comparison

## Setting Up the Cost Equations

Let $x$ = distance in kilometers.

- **Taxi Mini:** $C_{\text{Mini}} = 400 + 150x$
- **Taxi Maksi:** $C_{\text{Maksi}} = 300 + 160x$

## A) Distance = 5 km

| Taxi | Calculation | Cost |
|------|------------|------|
| Mini | $400 + 150 \times 5$ | $400 + 750 = 1150$ tolars |
| Maksi | $300 + 160 \times 5$ | $300 + 800 = 1100$ tolars |

**Taxi Maksi is cheaper** (by 50 tolars).

## B) Distance = 15 km

| Taxi | Calculation | Cost |
|------|------------|------|
| Mini | $400 + 150 \times 15$ | $400 + 2250 = 2650$ tolars |
| Maksi | $300 + 160 \times 15$ | $300 + 2400 = 2700$ tolars |

**Taxi Mini is cheaper** (by 50 tolars).

## C) Equal Cost — Solving for $x$

$$400 + 150x = 300 + 160x$$
$$400 - 300 = 160x - 150x$$
$$100 = 10x$$
$$x = 10 \text{ km}$$

**Verification:** $400 + 150(10) = 1900$ and $300 + 160(10) = 1900$ ✓

## D) When is each taxi more cost-effective?

- **$x < 10$ km:** Maksi is cheaper (its lower starting fee of 300 outweighs the extra 10 tolar/km for short trips).
- **$x = 10$ km:** Both cost exactly 1900 tolars.
- **$x > 10$ km:** Mini is cheaper (its lower rate of 150 tolar/km compensates for the higher 400 tolar starting fee on longer trips).

$$\boxed{
\begin{aligned}
\text{A) } &\text{Taxi Maksi is cheaper (1100 vs. 1150 tolars).}\\
\text{B) } &\text{Taxi Mini is cheaper (2650 vs. 2700 tolars).}\\
\text{C) } &x = 10 \text{ km (both cost 1900 tolars).}\\
\text{D) } &\text{Maksi for } x < 10\text{ km; Mini for } x > 10\text{ km.}
\end{aligned}
}$$
